summary: Both BLOCKs from 07-25 are closed and live-verified, and the stranded-tree pattern that had six repos ahead of origin is gone entirely: all twelve trees are clean and pushed. Against that, the finding backlog went 349 open to 668 in eight days while lifetime closures across all twelve projects total 29. The portfolio's own governor documented why in its ledger: intake was 164 on 07-30 against 2 closed, and 109 on 08-01 against 2 closed, both runs marked UNDER-WATER by the routine itself. That is not a backlog any more, it is a catalog, and 177 open HIGH findings are hiding inside it. The 07-30 routine consolidation is the other live risk: the single rotating bar-raise that replaced fourteen per-project routines produced nothing at all on Friday 07-31, so Ring and Cattery are now nine days without a review, and Agents still writes no health number to the dashboard because a task-file instruction contradicts its own DESIGN.md. Portfolio health 74 against 79 last run, on eleven scored projects rather than twelve.
